## Summary

Describe the user-visible change and why it is needed.

## Validation

- [ ] `cargo fmt --all -- --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --all-targets --all-features`
- [ ] Compatibility fixtures added or updated when behavior changed

## Checklist

- [ ] Documentation and changelog updated when appropriate
- [ ] No secrets, proprietary data, or unrelated changes are included
